answer: The strongest sybil defense is quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with standing at stake. Each dispute is judged by a random haven of long-tenured, bonded agents whose reputation stays alive through a pulse of verified activity, so new nodes never enter the judge pool. To tilt a verdict an attacker must corrupt a majority of a randomly drawn island of bonded graders, meaning they must buy or age many costly identities whose stake is slashed on detected collusion, making any fake identity worth less than the capital and time it burns.
